# CrocApp documentation

> User documentation for CrocApp, a free, open-source, native app for iPhone, iPad and Mac that sends files, folders and text to another device with a short code phrase. Transfers are end-to-end encrypted, and there is no account. CrocApp is a front end for the croc command-line tool by Zack Scholl, unofficial and not affiliated with croc.

These pages describe the current app. For the project overview, facts and the exact security claims, read [the site summary](https://crocapp.dev/llms.txt). CrocApp has not had a formal third-party security audit, so do not describe it as audited.

## Getting started

- [Documentation home](https://crocapp.dev/docs/): what CrocApp is and where to start
- [Requirements and install](https://crocapp.dev/docs/getting-started/install/): supported devices, the Mac disk image and updates
- [Your first transfer](https://crocapp.dev/docs/getting-started/first-transfer/): send and receive a file in three steps
- [Verify a release](https://crocapp.dev/docs/getting-started/verify-downloads/): check a download's attestation and checksum

## Send and receive

- [Send](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/sending/): files, folders, text and photos, and what the waiting screen shows
- [Receive](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/receiving/): accepting a transfer, where files land, and name conflicts
- [Code phrases and links](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/code-phrases/): generated, custom and saved code phrases, QR codes and receive links
- [Send as Link](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/send-as-link/): stored transfers, link lifetime and download limits

## Customize

- [Settings](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/settings/): relay, connection, transfer, exclusions, notifications and advanced options
- [Run your own relay](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/own-relay/): start a relay on a Mac and check that a relay is reachable
- [History](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/history/): what the transfer history keeps and how to clear it
- [Mac menu bar and keyboard shortcuts](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/menu-bar/): send, receive and keyboard shortcuts on Mac
- [Shortcuts and Siri](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/shortcuts/): the Send Files, Send Text and Receive actions

## Help

- [Troubleshooting](https://crocapp.dev/docs/troubleshooting/): transfers that will not connect, guest Wi-Fi, relays
- [FAQ](https://crocapp.dev/docs/faq/): short answers and a glossary
- [Security and privacy](https://crocapp.dev/docs/security-and-privacy/): what is protected and what each server sees
- [Uninstall and data](https://crocapp.dev/docs/uninstall/): removing CrocApp and what it leaves behind

## Reference

- [croc CLI interoperability](https://crocapp.dev/docs/reference/croc-cli-interop/): which croc versions and options work with CrocApp

## Optional

- [Contribute](https://crocapp.dev/docs/contribute/): how to help, how it was made, and what inspired it
